summary: Short kerb at a junction, too steep at 11-13% with houses 15 m away.
reasons: Starts at the junction, only 17 m long

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings sit 15 m and 16 m away on this side, with more within 25 m.

drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street with a pedestrian crossing at the corner.

flags: Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Heavy trees south-east shade the morning; open to the afternoon sun.
